facts.c: Anirban Survivor Voice Foundation said Cambodian authorities had accepted a list of 1,797 Bangladeshis to return, and about 400 more were in the same situation (October 2026).
facts.q: ইতোমধ্যে ১ হাজার ৭৯৭ বাংলাদেশির তালিকা কম্বোডিয়া কর্তৃপক্ষ গ্রহণ করেছে এবং আরও প্রায় ৪০০ জন একই ধরনের সংকটে রয়েছেন

facts.c: The group said many Bangladeshis went to Cambodia with valid passports, visas and government clearance but were forced into illegal work in online-scam compounds.
facts.q: অনেক বাংলাদেশি বৈধ পাসপোর্ট, ভিসা ও সরকারি ছাড়পত্র নিয়ে কম্বোডিয়ায় গেলেও সেখানে তাদের জোরপূর্বক বিভিন্ন অনলাইন স্ক্যাম কম্পাউন্ডে অবৈধ কাজ করতে বাধ্য করা হচ্ছে

facts.c: The group asked the government to apply the international non-punishment principle so trafficking victims are not treated as criminals.
facts.q: আন্তর্জাতিক অ-শাস্তি নীতি (নন পানিশমেন্ট প্রিন্সিপাল) অনুসরণেরও জোর দাবি

facts.c: In May 2026 Cambodia waived visa overstay fines for 602 Nepalis after their embassy in Bangkok, also accredited to Cambodia, intervened.
facts.q: waived visa overstay fines for 602 Nepali nationals

facts.c: Nepal's embassy in Bangkok prepared one-way travel documents and sent them to Cambodia for overstayers whose passports were lost or expired.
facts.q: one-way travel documents had already been prepared and sent to Cambodia for those individuals

facts.c: Nepal's embassy said Cambodia's new legal provisions let authorities arrest, fine and imprison foreigners who fail to leave within one month.
facts.q: allow authorities to arrest, fine and imprison foreign nationals who fail to leave the country within one month

facts.c: People whose fines were waived had to send their travel details to Cambodia's immigration department as soon as they had air tickets.
facts.q: immediately send their travel details to Cambodia

facts.c: Thai Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul said in May 2026 that Thai-Cambodian border checkpoints would stay closed until Cambodia accepted Thailand's conditions.
facts.q: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul also reaffirmed in May 2026 that Thai-Cambodian border checkpoints would remain closed until Cambodia accepted conditions set by Thailand.

facts.c: On 1 June 2026 the Ban Khlong Luek-Poipet crossing and every other checkpoint in Sa Kaeo province remained closed.
facts.q: there was currently no reopening of the permanent Ban Khlong Luek-Poipet border crossing, or any other border checkpoint in Sa Kaeo province
